scope: Original uncapped Taxi/RAF/Intermittent MLP4/MLP16/AllAvailable/CurrentOnly full Validation and Test stored metrics only. User authorized Test comparison. No training/inference/server calls/CNN access.
aggregation: Arithmetic mean of three per-seed event-level RMSE/MAE; sample SD ddof1; no ensemble; no pooling across datasets.
checkpoint_selection: first strict finite minimum fullValidation original raw quantity RMSE; same selected checkpoint for Validation/Test; no reselection

limitations: Original uncapped targets and Q3-capped targets are different outcomes. Their absolute RMSE/MAE cannot establish relative superiority; comparison must be labeled separate tasks.

All36Test rows have direct shared target/truth/loader digest checks; 24Validation rows reuse frozen selected endpoint aggregates without per-target/truth digests. These use shared original population references and selected state/count linkage, not a fresh row replay claim.
Original raw training/evaluation runtime provenance varies; MLP16 Taxi/RAF seed42 evaluation is macOS CPU Torch2.14.0, while most other native evaluations use RTX5080 CUDA Torch2.11.0/cuDNN91900.
A minimum over four arm means after looking at Test is descriptive post hoc best, not Validation-based architecture selection or independent confirmatory improvement.
No raw versus Cap per-target error or causal decomposition performed here; no model/CNN/checkpoint/results changed.
External model comparison is handled separately by the parent task; these rows alone do not establish external superiority.
